'''Bruschetta''' is the meal of [[tomatoes]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Strength}} II for 2 minutes 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bruschetta.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Tomatoes, [[cheese]] and [[bread]] (or [[naan]]). Picking up tomatoes unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating bruschetta takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Strength II for 2:30.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
